TRIP-004.name: Trip.outcomeOf
TRIP-004.ears: THE SYSTEM SHALL combine the results of the gate's checks into one outcome.

criteria.ears: IF any check failed THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refer the traveler, and only then.
IF no check failed and a check rests on an undecided point THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the outcome undecided, and only then.
IF every check passed THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL give the outcome Board, and only then.

TRIP-003.name: Trip.gateShows
TRIP-003.ears: THE SYSTEM SHALL show a result at the gate only for a trip the traveler presented, and Board only when nothing stands against it.

criteria.ears: IF a trip is not presented THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL show the gate waiting.
IF the gate shows a result on any path THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have had the traveler's shares.
IF a traveler holds one credential THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT show Board.
IF a trip rests on an undecided point THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL show neither Board nor Refer.
IF the gate shows Board THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have a presented trip, nothing undecided and no check against it.

TRIP-002.name: Trip.act
TRIP-002.ears: THE SYSTEM SHALL send nothing to the website or the gate until the traveler shares it in the wallet.

criteria.ears: IF a trip reaches the gate THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have come from the wallet's consent sheet by its Share.
IF any path of a traveler's actions reaches the gate THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have had both of the traveler's shares on that trip.
IF a trip is short of the gate on any path THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have sent the gate nothing.
WHEN a traveler declines THE SYSTEM SHALL send nothing.
IF a trip stands at a decline of the website's request on any path THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have sent the website nothing.
IF a trip stands at a decline at the gate on any path THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL have sent the gate nothing.

TRIP-001.name: Trip.next
TRIP-001.ears: THE SYSTEM SHALL move a trip only by the steps of its route.

criteria.ears: THE SYSTEM SHALL let a trip reach the gate by following the route's stops in order.
WHEN a traveler takes the action at a stop THE SYSTEM SHALL move the trip to the next stop.
IF a trip is short of the gate THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL offer an action that moves it on.
